name: record_events
description:
Record remote cache usage events. Each event in requestBody has a sessionId, a source (LOCAL or REMOTE), an event type (HIT or MISS), the artifact hash, and an optional duration (time taken to generate the artifact, for HIT events).

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v8/artifacts/events --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

duration.description: The time taken to generate the artifact. This should be sent as a body parameter on `HIT` events.

event.description: One of `HIT` or `MISS`. `HIT` specifies that a cached artifact for `hash` was found in the cache. `MISS` specifies that a cached artifact with `hash` was not found.

sessionId.description: A UUID (universally unique identifer) for the session that generated this event.

source.description: One of `LOCAL` or `REMOTE`. `LOCAL` specifies that the cache event was from the user's filesystem cache. `REMOTE` specifies that the cache event is from a remote cache.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

xArtifactClientCi.description: The continuous integration or delivery environment where this artifact is downloaded.

xArtifactClientInteractive.description: 1 if the client is an interactive shell. Otherwise 0
